items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: I remember playing a picture called the Night Nurse, I think it was Colleen Moore

ctx.x: He was a banjo player, he lived on East 34th Street in Los Angeles. What else can you tell us about the moving picture?
It's pretty hard to remember exactly, because we did so many in those days and there were so many one day affairs. You did the work for that day and
then you'd wait for the next call or something like that.
